column1: # Homophonic substitution cipher used by Duke of Mayenne writing to commander de Diou, Paris, 13 May 1593
# (BnF fr.3984, f.7-10). Reconstructed by S. Tomokiyo; the same cipher is BnF fr.3995 no.55 (f.98, 1592),
# endorsed "Chiffre de monsieur duma[yne] auec le Chevalier de Dyou". Source image:
# NOT the cipher used in fr.2751 (that item's own encipherment is unread this pass, see NOTES.md) --
# captured here only for a later mechanical trial against a transcribed fr.2751 ciphertext.
# sign = this repo's ASCII code; glyph = terse description of Tomokiyo's drawing (row 1 / primary symbol
# per letter only -- his image also shows 2nd-4th homophone rows and a "double letters" row per column
# that are NOT transcribed here, grade M/low confidence: the source image is a small compressed web
# thumbnail (~55px per cell) and several row-1 glyphs are themselves hard to tell apart at this
# resolution (grade M throughout). value = the letter; source = column position in mayenne3.png row 1.
# A future pass should re-derive this from the BnF fr.3984 or fr.3995 page image directly, at full
# resolution, before relying on it for a keyed reading.
